summary: A flat hourly price per size, idle time included, from a $19 plan that comes back as usage.

egress.note: No price is published beyond the allowance; Lizard asks you to contact it first.
egress.included: 2 TB per account over a rolling 30 days

notes: Between sessions the machine is paused, not stopped: a stopped sandbox is deleted. No storage charge for a paused sandbox is published.
Extra disk is a volume at $0.14 per GB-month of used space.
Sandbox egress is included up to 2 TB per rolling 30 days; the price beyond that is not published.
Pro 5x ($99) and Pro 20x ($499) include the same amount of usage as their fee and raise the sandbox limits; they never lower a bill, so the calculator lands on Pro unless you need the higher limits.

upkeep.label: Updates not published
upkeep.detail: Sandboxes run Lizard's own templates and are deleted on stop unless you keep a volume. Lizard does not say whether it updates hosted apps such as n8n or OpenClaw for you.

source.quote: The public CLI does not provide a custom-template upload flow.
